note: Corrections agencies have sent about their own directory entries, applied straight onto their `agency` documents in Sanity by ./apply-agency-corrections.mjs. This file is the record of what each agency said and when, not a source of truth: once applied, Studio owns the document, and re-running only fills fields that are still empty or still missing a link. Supersedes scripts/agency-listing-import/agency-listings.json, which seeded the deprecated `agencyListing` overlay - see 'The agencyListing overlay is deprecated' in app/directory/README.md.

corrections.provenance: Reply to directory outreach, 16 September 2026, and a follow-up the same day. Confirmed the client list on the page (Floema, Phive, Jeton) as correct, so no client changes here. Budget was quoted as ">50k Branding" and ">100k Website" with no currency symbol; the follow-up confirmed euros and asked for the quotes to come off the page - they send them on contact. So the figures are removed from the record rather than banded at render like every other agency's: this dataset is publicly readable, and a figure left in it is a figure published. The label carries the band instead, which is what they agreed to. The timeline answer renders as the one exclusion chip; an engagement note beside it would only restate it, so the field is cleared.

set.budgetLabel: Branding from 5 figures; websites from 6 figures
exclusions: Timelines shorter than three months from start to finish

corrections.provenance: Reply to directory outreach, 16 September 2026. Confirmed the page as correct and sent seven more projects by URL, each the brand's own site. corrections.provenance: Reply to directory outreach, 16 September 2026. Confirmed everything but the review figures, and asked whether they came from Google - they did not, the record is sourced from Semrush (agencies.semrush.com/bizopia), which published 4.8 from 30 when this record was collected and 5.0 from 27 when it was checked on 16 September 2026. The figure here is the agency's own: 33 reviews at five stars. RECORDED ON INSTRUCTION, over the objection that the profile still cites Semrush for its figures and Semrush does not publish this one. Needs --force, because it overwrites what a named source published.

Reply to directory outreach, 15 September 2026, folded in during the Sanity migration - the client list, the awards note and the exclusions are already on the record and are not touched here. Only the budget label changes, to match the directory-wide move from quotes to bands (see `formatBudgetBand`). Rubén volunteered "from EUR 15,000, typically EUR 25,000 to EUR 60,000" and did not ask for it to come off; the band is applied anyway because a quote shown for one agency beside a band for the next tells a visitor the second one is hiding something. The typical range survives as prose rather than as two more figures.
